blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A national coalition has urged the Senate to restore funding cuts to essential education programs in the proposed 2027 national budget and increase investments in underserved communities. In a statement on Wednesday, E-Net Coalition called for changes to the 2027 General Appropriations Bill following a Senate panel hearing with civil society organizations on Oct. 26. The coalition said allocations for Special Needs Education (SNED), Indigenous Peoples Education and Madrasah Education remained below their 2026 levels despite increases in the House-approved budget.
